alt: Guhae kneels and lifts the leaf crown of Gaya to King Buphung.
Muryuk holds the ford in steel lamellar and the purple-plume Gaya helm.
Guhae in the council’s white robe faces his son. Muryuk will not take the purple-plume helm off.
Princess Ayang finds Muryuk in the yard, still in the Gaya helm.
Muryuk in the purple-plume helm on the gate road. Sadaham is ahead at the gate.
After the council, Guhae and King Buphung plan the marriage in an empty hall.
